Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

1. Scope — Covers dimensional and other requirements for iVIeurig Williams spinal bone plate with

FIG. 1 PLATE, BOt^E, SPINAL, MEURIG WILLIAMS, STRAIGHT 

3. Material — Any of the materials specified in 3 of IsrSS^T-ISeS 'General requirements of metal 
surgical implants'. 

4. Manufacture, Workmanship and Finish 

4.1 Spinal bone plate shall consist of a pair of plates with four hexagonal headed bolts each with a 
nut and washer. Two additional bolts, nuts and washers shall also be supplied with each pair 
of plates. 

4.2 The slots shall be well made and uniformly spaced and shall be symmetrical with respect to the 
central line. 

4.3 The threads on the nuts and bol^ shall be clean and well formed. 

4.4 The serrations at nuts and washers shall match with that of the plates. 

4.5 The plates, nuts, washers and bolts shall be free from pits, cracks, burrs, blemishes and other 
surface defects. 

4.6 The plates, nuts, washers and bolts shall be polished bright and passivated.

5. Tests 

5.1 Corrosion Resistance Fesf — Accprding to 6.1 of IS : 5347-1969. 

5.2 Radiological fesf — According to 6.2 of IS : 5347-1969. 

6. Marking — According to 5.1 of IS : 534t-1969. 

6.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indiaa^Standards Institution. 

7. Packing — The plates, nuts, washers and bolts may be packed as agreed to between the purchaser 
and the supplier. However it is recommended that each component may be wrapped in polyethylene 
bag or in wax paper and then packed in cartons.
